description: Give Plumbline the buyer's requirement, or a correction or addition to it, in their own words: it is read into a structured requirement (each value says which words it came from), conflicting or unclear facts come back as one question, and words not yet read are kept as written. Pass the requirement (id, token) from the first answer to continue it. Nothing is sent or ordered: send_requirement sends it when the buyer says so. When you already have the fields in structured form, use submit_request instead.

id.description: The requirement id from an earlier answer

token.description: Its private token (also the receipt token of the request it is sent as); keep it private

timezone.description: The buyer's IANA time zone, for reading dates

turn_id.description: Your id for this message: a retry with the same id is applied once

name: interpret_requirement
title: Describe a need to Plumbline in words
